neighbours.label: the token ' Mix' (capitalised, e.g. the imperative that opens a recipe step); weak and broad pole
fire: Preheat the oven to 350 F. Mix the oats and honey together in a large bowl.
Chop the onions finely. Mix them with the minced beef and a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter in a small pan. Mix it into the dry ingredients until smooth.
Soak the raisins overnight. Mix the flour, sugar and spices in a second bowl.
For the hike we packed water, apples and a bag of Trail Mix for the kids.
The record ends with an Extended Mix of the title track.
Drain the beans well. Mix in the chopped parsley and the lemon juice.
Whisk the eggs for a minute. Mix the cream and the sugar in a jug.
quiet: Preheat the oven to 350 F. Stir the oats and honey together in a large bowl.
Chop the onions finely. Combine them with the minced beef and a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter in a small pan. Pour it into the dry ingredients until smooth.
Soak the raisins overnight. Sift the flour, sugar and spices in a second bowl.
For the hike we packed water, apples and a bag of salted nuts for the kids.
The record ends with a longer version of the title track.
Drain the beans well. Fold in the chopped parsley and the lemon juice.
Whisk the eggs for a minute. Blend the cream and the sugar in a jug.
